question: Should OpenClaw restore the full historical `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` method surface, or only the object-identical `turn === inbound` alias proposed here?
rationale: Both choices are plausible: the object-identical alias is leaner and fixes reported `turn.run` crashes, but the shipped pre-removal contract also exposed additional `turn` method names that this PR does not restore.

options.title: Complete Legacy Alias Then Land
options.body: Restore the historical `turn` method names or otherwise prove they are intentionally unsupported, then land the compatibility repair after the branch refresh.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias
options.body: Land the object-identical alias as a deliberate narrow compatibility path for `turn.run` and current inbound names, accepting that some older turn methods remain unsupported.

options.title: Reject Runtime Compat
options.body: Close or pause the PR and require affected plugins to republish against `channel.inbound.*` instead of preserving the old host runtime surface.

recommendation.title: Complete Legacy Alias Then Land
recommendation.body: Restore the historical `turn` method names or otherwise prove they are intentionally unsupported, then land the compatibility repair after the branch refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: The original alias-removal commit and related compatibility/product boundary are tied most directly to this history.
